quickrebind.screen.title: QuickRebind
quickrebind.screen.subtitle: %s binds in this install
quickrebind.screen.empty_hint: Set your keys up how you like, then save them below.
quickrebind.row.label: %s  (%s binds)
quickrebind.tip.copy: Export this preset: puts a share code on your clipboard to send to someone else
quickrebind.tip.folder: Open the folder your presets are saved in — %s
quickrebind.tip.save_current: Save the keys you are using right now as a new preset
quickrebind.tip.paste: Read a share code from the clipboard and save it as a preset
quickrebind.tip.undo: Put the binds back the way they were before the last apply
quickrebind.confirm.apply.title: Apply "%s"?
quickrebind.confirm.apply.message: This overwrites your current keybinds. You can undo it straight afterwards.
quickrebind.confirm.delete.title: Delete "%s"?
quickrebind.confirm.delete.message: The preset file is removed from the shared folder. This cannot be undone.
quickrebind.prompt.save.title: Save current binds
quickrebind.prompt.save.message: What should this preset be called?
quickrebind.prompt.rename.title: Rename preset
quickrebind.status.conflicts: Heads up: %s binds now share a key with another bind
quickrebind.status.not_installed: %s binds belong to mods that aren't here — kept in the file
quickrebind.status.unreadable: %s entries name a key this version doesn't know
quickrebind.status.saved_where: Stored outside the instance, so every modpack can see it
quickrebind.status.save_failed: Could not write the preset file — see the log
quickrebind.status.copied: Share code for "%s" copied to the clipboard
quickrebind.status.copied_hint: Paste it anywhere — or send the file itself: %s
quickrebind.status.import_failed: That clipboard text isn't a QuickRebind code
quickrebind.status.delete_failed: Could not delete that preset — see the log
quickrebind.import.error.prefix: A share code starts with QRB1.
quickrebind.import.error.malformed: The code is damaged or was cut short
quickrebind.settings.title: QuickRebind Settings
quickrebind.option.missing_policy.tip: What to do with a bind the preset says nothing about — usually a modded bind when you apply a vanilla preset.
quickrebind.option.confirm.tip: Show a confirmation before a preset overwrites your current binds.
quickrebind.option.auto_apply.tip: Apply this preset every time the game starts. Handy on a dedicated instance, so its binds are always right.
